lessons.label: Lesson 5 — Big Number Roots
lessons.title: Albanian Tosk Big Number Roots
notes: sq / lesson-5 — Albanian Big Numbers (roots × multipliers 1–9)
Expanded from the original 8 root cards to the full 56-card set per
the approved Albanian number dataset review (FINAL, Rob 2026-06-17):
6 roots (hundreds, thousands, millions, billions, trillions,
quadrillions) × 9 multipliers = 54, PLUS the 2 kept standalone cards
10,000 (dhjetë mijë) and 100,000 (njëqind mijë) = 56 total.
Prompts stay comma-formatted strings as before. Schema unchanged:
{prompt, answer, hint, audio}.

lesson-5.001: Hundreds 100–900 — …qind (one word)
lesson-5.010: Thousands 1,000–9,000 — … mijë (two words)

lesson-5.028: Billions 1B–9B — … miliard (two words)
lesson-5.037: Trillions 1T–9T — … trilion (two words)
lesson-5.046: Quadrillions 1Q–9Q — … kuadrilion (two words)

prompt = the letter, answer = the phonetic SOUND, hint = 3 example words.

The engine rotates which single example shows across repeated views.
Albanian forms + phonetics are owned by the linguistics advisor and applied
VERBATIM here — engineers do not invent or alter them.
